open_points.subject: _authorize_photo_reference
open_points.text: - _authorize_photo_reference: [DEPENDENCY_BOUNDARY] MUST open exactly one transaction, read the photo only through tx.progress_photos().get_progress_photo with photo_id, and close that read transaction by exactly one rollback immediately after the read, marking it closed before it evaluates project scope or client visibility and before it raises PhotoValidationError; leaving the transaction open on any path, committing it, and using a legacy transaction-level photo method are forbidden.
open_points.other_text:
# PortalTransaction
def get_progress_photo(self, photo_id: UUID) -> ProgressPhoto | None
# PortalTransaction
def progress_photos(self) -> ProgressPhotoRepository
open_points.question: Must get_progress_photo be declared on ProgressPhotoRepository, or must the requirement permit the contracted PortalTransaction.get_progress_photo operation?

open_points.subject: list_progress_photos
open_points.text: - list_progress_photos: [DEPENDENCY_BOUNDARY] MUST open exactly one transaction, read only through tx.progress_photos().list_project_photos with context.project_id, and close that read transaction by exactly one rollback immediately after the read, marking it closed before it filters viewer visibility or orders the result; visibility filtering and ordering belong to this function, not to persistence, and it MUST NOT use a legacy transaction-level photo method.
open_points.other_text:
# PortalTransaction
def list_project_photos(self, project_id: UUID) -> list[ProgressPhoto]
# PortalTransaction
def progress_photos(self) -> ProgressPhotoRepository
open_points.question: Must list_project_photos be declared on ProgressPhotoRepository, or must the requirement permit the contracted PortalTransaction.list_project_photos operation?

open_points.subject: publish_progress_photo
open_points.text: - publish_progress_photo: [DEPENDENCY_BOUNDARY] MUST open exactly one transaction with store.begin(), which returns a PortalTransaction, read the replay candidate only through tx.progress_photos().get_progress_photo_by_intake_id with publication.intake_id, resolve a supplied section only through tx.project_sections().get_project_section with context.project_id inside that same transaction, insert only through tx.progress_photos().insert_progress_photo, append the audit only through tx.audit(), and on success commit exactly once (a replay or a validation failure closes it by rollback instead); it MUST NOT call validate_project_section, open a second transaction while its own is active, or use a legacy transaction-level photo or project-section method.

# PortalTransaction

open_points.question: Must the read, section lookup, and insert operations be declared on ProgressPhotoRepository and ProjectSectionRepository, or must the requirement permit the corresponding contracted PortalTransaction operations?

open_points.subject: update_progress_photo
open_points.text: - update_progress_photo: [DEPENDENCY_BOUNDARY] MUST open exactly one transaction, read the photo only through tx.progress_photos().get_progress_photo with photo_id, resolve a supplied section only through tx.project_sections().get_project_section with context.project_id inside that same transaction, write only through tx.progress_photos().update_progress_photo, append the audit only through tx.audit(), and on success commit exactly once (a replay or a validation failure closes it by rollback instead); it MUST NOT call validate_project_section, open a second transaction while its own is active, or use a legacy transaction-level photo or project-section method.
